CORRECTION 2026-11-01: an earlier version of this field said 'spans ~5 orders of magnitude', which overstated it.

control_E.diagnosis: the predeclared argument was wrong, not the threshold. It claimed removing gravity removes the normal force; it does not. With the floor still enabled, actuation itself drives voxels into the floor and generates transient normal force, so Coulomb friction still acts. Arm D, which removes the tangential coefficient, is the control that actually isolates friction, and it gives exactly zero. The threshold was not changed and this arm is recorded as missed.
control_E.magnitude: 0.0175 BL, which is 4.8% of the travelling arm and 11.4% of the longitudinal arm
